findings.detail: Angles: reuse and efficiency. When raw and normalized trees have identical IDs on both sides, this repeats the preceding comparison, starts another Git subprocess per repository and initialized submodule, and appends duplicate paths that are later deduplicated. Disposition: skipped because this pass is report-only.
findings.fix: Read raw-tree IDs into separate locals and run the second comparison only when its pair differs from the normalized pair already compared. Keep the normalized comparison first and preserve both comparisons whenever their inputs differ.
findings.title: cleanup-efficiency: Reuse the result when both tree comparisons have identical inputs.

strengths: Raw capture reuses the normalized inventory and existing recursive submodule boundary.
Normalized comparisons retain their existing failure handling.
